Quest name: Poison, Poison, and more Poison
Quest location: Naples Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r15 Ecological Research, r17 Biology, SPA(Spanish)
Pre-requisite discovery: Stinging Brush discovery (from "World's Deadly Poison" quest) + San Francisco
Pre-requisite action: Hunter's Growth 1 skill must be activated in order to see the quest
